title: V-MAGE: A Game Evaluation Framework for Assessing Vision-Centric Capabilities in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting statistical analysis to measure the number of sequential rounds where the model's output response remains unchanged despite new visual inputs, and calculating the correlation between this lack of responsiveness (anchoring on historical text instead of nuanced visual updates) and the model's overall performance (ELO score).
